reviews.text:
I've been going to the Bicocca Veterinary Clinic for several years, and it's now my trusted veterinarian. Oliver has always been treated with great professionalism, attention, and kindness, receiving attentive and meticulous care every time.

Both veterinarians are highly competent, helpful, and able to put both animals and their owners at ease, instilling trust and peace of mind.

I'm truly happy to have found a clinic where I can confidently entrust Oliver, knowing he'll always be treated with care and love. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for professionalism, expertise, and genuine attention for our four-legged friends!

Dr. Barbieri is my trusted veterinarian. She's very good with my many cats. Highly recommended!
Dr. Barbieri is an excellent professional, empathetic and loving.
What can I say... love for animals to the nth degree. They immediately understand the situation and explain the steps to follow in detail!
Helpful and truly good at their job, they understand the situation and make you think before making a decision.
